title: Optimize a page for AI Overviews and ChatGPT citations
summary: Paste a page and its primary question; get a clearer opening answer, takeaways, structure fixes, and a schema sketch. Treat inclusion in AI answers as a goal, not a promise.

tests.prompt:
Audit and rewrite this page so it is easier for search and AI answer engines to quote — without guaranteeing inclusion.

Primary question the page should answer: [QUESTION]
Page URL: [URL]
Current content: [PASTE]
Brand rules: [OPTIONAL]

Deliver:
1) Diagnosis: what blocks a clear, quotable answer today (bullets)
2) Rewritten opening answer: ≤120 words, plain language, no hype
3) Key takeaways: 3–5 bullets
4) Suggested H2/H3 fixes
5) FAQ pairs to add (2–4), only if grounded in the content
6) Schema suggestion: FAQPage or Article JSON-LD sketch using only facts from the page
7) Claims to remove or source (list)

Do not invent statistics, awards, or product features. If a claim lacks a source, flag it.

setup.agent: Chat model with the full page pasted; optional crawl step via your own tools
steps: Pick one money page and the question it should answer.
Paste the content into the prompt and run the audit.
Apply the opening answer and heading fixes on the real page.
Validate any JSON-LD in Google’s rich results test.
Re-check the page in a few weeks; do not expect instant Overview placement.
setup.approvalStep: A human must approve every factual change and remove unsourced claims before publish.
failureModes: Oversimplifying until the answer is wrong
Stripping needed nuance from the original

toolPicks.why: Queue URLs from a sheet into audit drafts.
toolPicks.whenNot: You optimize a page at a time.

toolPicks.why: Notify an editor when an audit draft is ready.

faq.q: Will this get me into Google AI Overviews?
faq.a: We will publish evidence here once we have a sourced figure. Until then, treat clear answers and valid structure as good practice, not a guarantee.
Schema can help machines understand the page when it matches visible content. Invalid or mismatched markup does not help.
